entities.summary: Bâḳî (باقى) was the pen name of the Ottoman Turkish poet Mahmud Abdülbâkî. Considered one of the greatest contributors to Turkish literature. Bâkî came to be known as Sultânüş-şuarâ, or "Sultan of poets".
